meta.title: Australia - Adelaide & Kangaroo Island 2027
meta.dates: Dec 16, 2027 – (continues) · Miami → San Francisco → Adelaide → Kangaroo Island

route.name: Adelaide
route.sub: 2 nights · Adelaide Marriott (2 connecting rooms, Bonvoy points)

route.name: Kangaroo Island
route.sub: 3 nights · Villas on the Bay, Kingscote

blocks.title: Arrive MIA — United check-in and bag drop
blocks.detail:
• ~3 hrs before departure: holiday-week crowds, family of 4, checked bags tagged all the way to Adelaide (one ticket).
• Have all 4 passports and the Australian ETA approvals ready — the agent checks them at MIA.
• Booster seats for the rental car go in as checked items (most airlines carry them free).
blocks.flag: Confirm the 2027 United schedule once it loads (~Jan 2027): this plan assumes the Thursday SFO → Adelaide flight still runs and that MIA → SFO still leaves ~4:30 PM.

blocks.title: TSA PreCheck — then snacks for the plane
blocks.detail:
• PreCheck lane for all four.
• Buy snacks and refill water bottles after security — the SFO leg spans dinner time but dinner is planned at SFO.
blocks.notes: • ~USD 25 for snacks and water — estimated.

blocks.title: At the gate — bathroom stop, boarding
blocks.detail: • Boarding starts ~40 min before departure.

blocks.title: United - MIA → SFO - Nonstop - ~6h30m
blocks.detail:
• Departs 4:37 PM Eastern, lands ~8:09 PM Pacific (3 hrs behind Florida).
• Same ticket as the Adelaide flight — bags checked through.
• Kids: no nap longer than 45 min; the long sleep is on the next flight.
blocks.notes:
• Not booked. Priced together with the Adelaide flight below (one United award ticket).
• Seen on Google Flights for a Jan 7, 2027 stand-in date: United MIA 4:37 PM → SFO, 2h31m connection, → ADL 9:30 AM two days later.

blocks.title: SFO — walk Terminal 3 → International Terminal G
blocks.detail:
• From: the arrival gate in Terminal 3 (United domestic).
• To: International Terminal G — follow the "International Departures / G Gates" signs along the airside connector; no re-screening.
• ~10–15 min walk with kids; bathroom stop on the way.

blocks.title: Dinner airside — International Terminal G
blocks.detail:
• Full dinner here so everyone can skip the onboard meal and sleep after takeoff.
• Light on sugar and caffeine.
blocks.notes: • ~USD 80 for 2 adult + 2 kids' meals at SFO airport prices, incl. tax and tip — estimated.

blocks.title: Wind down — pajamas, teeth, quiet time
blocks.detail:
• Kids change into pajamas at the gate restroom and brush teeth.
• No new movies started.

blocks.title: Board UA207
blocks.detail: • Boarding ~45 min before departure; last bathroom stop at the gate.

blocks.title: United UA207 - SFO → ADL - Nonstop - ~15h50m
blocks.detail:
• Boeing 787-9, Economy, 4 passengers.
• Crosses the International Date Line — Friday Dec 17 disappears in flight.
• Lands 9:30 AM Saturday Dec 18, Adelaide time (ACDT, UTC+10:30 — 15.5 hrs ahead of Florida).
• Sleep plan: dinner already eaten, lights out right after takeoff.
blocks.notes:
• Not booked — planning assumption: 55,000 United miles + ~USD 34 per person (MIA → SFO → ADL on one award) → 220,000 miles + ~USD 136 for four. Chase Ultimate Rewards transfers 1:1 to United.
• seats.aero (Nov 2026, Dec 2026 season): UA207 economy saver 55,000 United / 60,000 Aeroplan / 61,800 JetBlue / 48,000 Velocity, 9 seats on most dates; the first 2 flights of the season priced 128,800–146,800.
• For Dec 2025 flights the 55,000 saver first appeared Apr 2025 and stayed open to departure.
• Business: 300,000–400,000 United miles (lowest ever seen 200,000) — not realistic.
• Cash stand-in (Google Flights, Jan 7, 2027): ~USD 2,487 per person one way MIA → SFO → ADL → ~USD 9,950 for four.
• Alaska and Delta miles can't be used: United is Star Alliance.
blocks.flag: Seasonal route: 2026–27 runs Dec 17 – Feb 8 only (cut from 49 to 23 round trips). Dec 2027 isn't scheduled yet — if the season starts later than Dec 16, this day moves.

days.title: Land Adelaide → Glenelg beach → check in

blocks.title: Arrive ADL — immigration, bags, biosecurity
blocks.detail:
• SmartGate for adult US e-passports; kids use the staffed lane with a parent.
• Declare all food — no fruit or snacks off the plane.
• 75 min gate-to-curb for a family with checked bags.

blocks.title: Pick up rental car — ADL terminal car park
blocks.detail:
• Mid-size SUV for 4 + luggage; fit the boosters before leaving the lot.
• This car stays on the mainland: it gets parked at Cape Jervis on Monday while the family crosses to Kangaroo Island on foot.
• Any major company works since the car never goes on the ferry.
blocks.notes:
• Not booked. Kayak, furthest searchable date (Nov 20–25, 2027): compact SUV ~USD 36/day, 5-day total ~USD 212.
• December school-holiday pricing runs higher: ~USD 60/day × 6 days (Dec 18–23) ≈ USD 360 — estimated.
• Child seats: kids 6 and 8 need boosters in South Australia until they fit the adult belt — bring your own or rent (~AUD 15/day each, capped) — not included above.

blocks.title: Drive ADL → Glenelg, Moseley Square
blocks.detail:
• ~6 km, 12–15 min.
• Park at the Holdfast Shores / Moseley Square paid car parks (2-hr+).
blocks.notes: • Glenelg paid parking ~AUD 15 for ~3 hrs — estimated.

blocks.title: Walk Glenelg Jetty
blocks.detail:
• From: the car park → Moseley Square → straight out the jetty (~215 m each way).
• Easy leg-stretch after the flight.

blocks.title: Lunch — The Moseley Bar & Kitchen, 11 Moseley Square
blocks.detail:
• Beachside, on the square at the foot of the jetty; kitchen opens 12 PM.
• Kids' meals come with a soft drink.
blocks.notes:
• Line items (verified, Sept 2026 menu): Battered Flathead AUD 27.50 + Aussie Wagyu Cheeseburger AUD 28.50 + 2 kids' meals AUD 15 each = AUD 86.00.
• Prices include GST; +10% tip (optional in Australia) = AUD 94.60 ≈ USD 61.
• 10% surcharge on public holidays (not this date).

blocks.title: Glenelg Beach + foreshore playground
blocks.detail:
• Calm, shallow bay beach right off Moseley Square.
• Water is ~66–68°F in mid-December — expect paddling more than swimming.
• Shade breaks; sunscreen — the Australian UV index is extreme in December.

blocks.title: Rinse off sand, change, back to the car
blocks.detail: • Foreshore showers by the square; dry clothes from the carry-on.

blocks.title: Drive Glenelg → Adelaide Marriott, 141 King William St
blocks.detail: • ~11 km, 25 min straight up Anzac Hwy.

blocks.title: Check in — Adelaide Marriott Hotel (2 connecting rooms)
blocks.detail:
• Inside the restored General Post Office on King William St, Victoria Square end of the CBD.
• 2 Superior rooms, 2 double beds each, connecting (each room sleeps 3 max — no single room fits 4 on points).
• Indoor pool.
blocks.notes:
• Not booked — Dec 2027 opens ~Dec 2026 (furthest check-in today is Nov 13, 2027).
• Furthest-date reference (marriott.com, Oct 18–20, 2027): Superior 2 Double 112,000 pts per room for 2 nights → 224,000 for 2 rooms.
• Same dates in cash: ~AUD 531/night per room → ~AUD 2,124 for 2 rooms × 2 nights (~USD 1,380) → ~0.6¢ per point.
• The only room that takes 4 is the Two-Bedroom (accessible) at ~AUD 982/night, cash only.
• Credit-card surcharge 1.95% on cash charges.
blocks.flag: Points value is poor here (~0.6¢). Cash alternative near the beach: The George, Glenelg — Superior Family Room, 2 bedrooms, AUD 1,271 for Dec 18–20, 2027 (booking.com, free cancellation).

blocks.title: Hotel parking — valet
blocks.detail:
• On-site valet with in/out privileges.
• Cheaper option: off-site self-park at the Auto Park ~400 m away.
blocks.notes: • Valet AUD 70/day (marriott.com) × 2 nights = AUD 140 ≈ USD 91 — verified rate.

blocks.title: Rest — short nap (45 min max) or indoor pool
blocks.detail: • Cap naps at 45 min to reset to Adelaide time.

blocks.title: Walk to Citi Zen, 401 King William St
blocks.detail: • From: hotel entrance on King William St → south through Victoria Square → continue on King William St to no. 401 (~800 m, 10 min).

blocks.title: Dinner — Citi Zen (Chinese), 401 King William St
blocks.detail:
• Kid-friendly Chinese with quick table turnover.
• Early seating to keep bedtime on track.
blocks.notes: • ~AUD 110 for 2 adult mains + 2 kids' plates with rice, incl. optional 10% tip — estimated; menu prices not confirmed online.

blocks.title: Walk back to the hotel
blocks.detail: • Same route north on King William St (~10 min).

blocks.title: Bedtime routine — lights out 7:30 PM
blocks.detail: • Early night to beat the jet lag.

days.title: Adelaide Hills — Mount Lofty, strawberry picking, Hahndorf

blocks.title: Breakfast — hotel
blocks.detail: • Buffet at Penny Blue, in the hotel.
blocks.notes: • ~AUD 45 per adult buffet (hotels.com listing) + kids ~AUD 22.50 each ≈ AUD 135 — estimated; check whether Bonvoy elite breakfast applies.

blocks.title: Get ready — sunscreen, hats, water bottles
blocks.detail: • Valet car requested for 8:30.

blocks.title: Drive → Mount Lofty Summit
blocks.detail: • ~16 km, 25 min up the South Eastern Fwy; free parking at the summit.

blocks.title: Mount Lofty Summit lookout
blocks.detail:
• Highest point in the Adelaide Hills — the whole city and coast laid out below.
• Short walk around the obelisk lookout; bathrooms at the summit.

blocks.title: Drive → Beerenberg Farm, 2106 Mount Barker Rd, Hahndorf
Pick your own strawberries — Beerenberg Farm
blocks.detail:
• Pay at the Farm Shop, grab a basket, pick in the patch.
• The patch closes some days when it's "picked out" — check beerenberg.com.au that morning.
• Picking season Nov–Apr; patch entry 9 AM – 4:15 PM; closed Christmas Day.
blocks.notes: • Entry AUD 5 per adult, kids under 12 free (Dec 2025) + ~1 kg berries at AUD 13.50/kg = AUD 23.50 ≈ USD 15 — verified Dec 2025 prices; 2027 may differ.

blocks.title: Drive → Hahndorf main street (Mount Barker Rd)
blocks.detail: • ~1 km, 3 min; park behind the main street.

blocks.title: Lunch — Hahndorf Inn, 35 Main St
blocks.detail: • Historic 1863 German pub; kids' menu incl. a juice box.
blocks.notes:
• Line items (verified, June 2026 menu): Classic Chicken Schnitzel AUD 31 + Fish & Chips AUD 29 + 2 kids' meals AUD 16 each = AUD 92.
• +10% optional tip = AUD 101.20 ≈ USD 66.
• 15% surcharge applies only on public holidays.

blocks.title: Walk Hahndorf's main street
blocks.detail:
• From: Hahndorf Inn → north-west along Main St to the Hahndorf Academy end and back (~1 km round trip).
• 1850s German settler village: old stone shopfronts, fudge and lolly shops.

blocks.title: Drive Hahndorf → hotel
blocks.detail: • ~28 km, 30–35 min on the South Eastern Fwy.

blocks.title: Hotel downtime — indoor pool
blocks.detail: • Pool, showers, repack for tomorrow's island move.

blocks.title: Dinner — Treasury 1860, 144 King William St
blocks.detail:
• In the old Treasury building directly across King William St from the hotel (1 min walk).
• Listed as child-friendly; book an early table.
blocks.notes: • ~AUD 130 for 2 adult mains + 2 kids' meals incl. optional 10% tip — estimated; current menu prices not confirmed online.

blocks.title: Pack + bedtime routine
blocks.detail: • Bags packed tonight — tomorrow leaves at 9 AM.

days.title: Drive to Cape Jervis → ferry → Penneshaw dolphin safari → Kingscote

blocks.title: Breakfast — hotel
blocks.detail: • Buffet at Penny Blue.
blocks.notes: • ~AUD 135 — estimated (same basis as Sunday).

blocks.title: Check out — load the car
blocks.detail: • Request the valet car at 8:30.

blocks.title: Drive Adelaide → Cape Jervis ferry terminal
blocks.detail:
• ~108 km, 1h45 via the Main South Rd through McLaren Vale and Normanville.
• Bathroom/fuel stop at Normanville (~1 hr in).
• Last fuel before the terminal is Aldinga — top up if low.
blocks.notes: • Fuel for the mainland driving so far (~250 km) ≈ AUD 45 — estimated.

blocks.title: Park at the SeaLink secure car park, Cape Jervis
blocks.detail:
• Mainland car stays here while you're on the island.
• Book the car park together with the ferry tickets.
blocks.notes: • AUD 25/day (SeaLink, verified) × 4 days (Dec 20–23) = AUD 100 ≈ USD 65.

blocks.title: Check in — SeaLink terminal (walk-on)
blocks.detail:
• Check-in closes 30 min before departure.
• Luggage goes on with you as walk-on passengers.

blocks.title: SeaLink ferry Cape Jervis → Penneshaw (45 min)
blocks.detail:
• 12:00 PM weekday departure on the current timetable.
• Ferries run daily except Christmas Day.
blocks.notes:
• Walk-on fares (one way): adult AUD 49 × 2 + child (3–14) AUD 25.50 × 2 = AUD 149.00 ≈ USD 97.
• Fares listed valid to Mar 31, 2026; peak departures can vary — re-check when booking. Not booked.
blocks.flag: A new ferry timetable with more departures was due from Nov 2026 — confirm the noon sailing still exists.

blocks.title: Pick up island car — Budget Kangaroo Island, Penneshaw ferry terminal
blocks.detail:
• Mid-size SUV; collected at the terminal, a short walk off the ferry.
• Budget KI cars are allowed on the island's sealed and unsealed roads.
• A 4WD isn't needed — the main roads are sealed and 2WD is fine on the gravel ones.
blocks.notes:
• Not booked. Budget KI listings start ~AUD 180/day; dynamic pricing → ~AUD 600 for 3 days — estimated.
• Kayak (furthest date, Nov 2027, Kingscote Airport): compact SUV ~USD 55/day.
• Mainland rentals: most ban the ferry or limit you to sealed roads (Thrifty bans 2WD cars on the island) — renting on the island avoids that.
blocks.flag: Ask Budget KI in writing that the vehicle and its insurance cover unsealed roads (the last stretch into Hanson Bay).

blocks.title: Lunch — Penneshaw Pub, 11 Thomas Willson St
blocks.detail: • Clifftop pub over Backstairs Passage, 3 min from the terminal; kids' meals include a soft drink.
blocks.notes: • Mains ~AUD 19–39 (Lonely Planet) → 2 adult mains + 2 kids' meals incl. optional 10% tip ≈ AUD 100 — estimated; current menu not online.

blocks.title: Drive to Christmas Cove Marina — check in
blocks.detail: • 500 m from the ferry terminal; check in 15 min before departure.

blocks.title: Kangaroo Island Ocean Safari — 75-minute coastal safari
blocks.detail:
• Small boat (12 max) along the Penneshaw coast: dolphins and seals guaranteed, plus sea eagles.
• Dry boat — spray jackets provided.
• Suitable for all ages.
blocks.notes:
• Adult AUD 88 × 2 + child (3–12) ~AUD 55 × 2 = AUD 286 ≈ USD 186 — adult verified; child rate from the AUD 55–88 range listed.
• Departs 9 AM and 3 PM daily. Not booked.

blocks.title: Back to the car
blocks.detail: • From the marina back up to the car (~2 min).

blocks.title: Drive Penneshaw → Kingscote
blocks.detail:
• ~60 km, 50 min on the sealed Hog Bay Rd.
• Watch for wallabies on the roadside.

blocks.title: Check in — Villas on the Bay, 9–11 Esplanade, Kingscote
blocks.detail:
• 2-bedroom villa (1 queen + 2 singles), full kitchen, laundry, lock-up garage; gated, opposite the bay and clifftop reserve.
• Short walk to town, jetties and the playground.
• First breakfast is complimentary.
blocks.notes:
• Booking.com, Dec 20–23, 2027 (searched Nov 2026): AUD 682 for 3 nights, 2 adults + 2 children (6, 8); free cancellation, no prepayment ≈ USD 443.
• Rated 9.3 (813 reviews).
• No Hyatt, Hilton or Marriott on the island. Southern Ocean Lodge (Hyatt via Mr & Mrs Smith) only takes children 10+.
• Larger hotel option: Ozone Hotel Family Room, pool + restaurant, AUD 1,006 for 3 nights. Not booked.

blocks.title: Dinner — Zone Restaurant, Ozone Hotel, 67 Chapman Tce
blocks.detail: • 5-min walk along the Esplanade; bistro over Nepean Bay — burgers, pasta, local seafood.
blocks.notes: • ~AUD 100 for 2 adult mains + 2 kids' meals incl. optional 10% tip — estimated; menu not online.

blocks.title: Groceries — Kingscote supermarket
blocks.detail: • Breakfasts, snacks and picnic water for the next three days.
blocks.notes: • ~AUD 120 — estimated.

blocks.title: Bedtime routine
blocks.detail: • Tomorrow leaves at 8:45 AM.

days.title: South coast — Seal Bay sea lions, birds of prey, Little Sahara dunes

blocks.title: Breakfast — villa
blocks.detail: • Complimentary first breakfast.

blocks.title: Pack the day bag
blocks.detail: • Water, hats, sunscreen, change of clothes for after the dunes.

blocks.title: Drive Kingscote → Seal Bay Conservation Park
blocks.detail: • ~57 km, 50 min, all sealed.

blocks.title: Seal Bay — guided sea lion tour (10:00 AM)
blocks.detail:
• Arrive 15 min before the tour.
• Australian sea lions resting on the beach and dunes; tour includes the 900 m boardwalk.
• Open 9 AM, last entry 4 PM; closed Christmas Day.
blocks.notes:
• Guided tour family (2A + 2C) AUD 110 ≈ USD 72 — verified.
• Boardwalk-only family ticket AUD 54.50.
blocks.flag: Beach access was paused in 2026 to protect the colony — tours run from the boardwalk instead. Check parks.sa.gov.au before booking.

blocks.title: Drive → Raptor Domain, 58 Seal Bay Rd
blocks.detail: • ~10 min; time to settle before the show.

blocks.title: Raptor Domain — free-flight Birds of Prey show
blocks.detail:
• Rescued wedge-tailed eagles, owls and kookaburras flying overhead (1 hr).
• Shows at 11:30 AM and 2:30 PM.
blocks.notes: • Family AUD 92 ≈ USD 60 — verified (South Australian Tourism listing).

blocks.title: Drive → Vivonne Bay General Store, 4417 South Coast Rd
Lunch — Vivonne Bay General Store
blocks.detail: • Home of the island's famous King George whiting burger; kids' cheeseburgers too.
blocks.notes: • ~AUD 80 for 2 whiting burgers + 2 kids' meals incl. chips — estimated; menu not online.

blocks.title: Drive → Little Sahara Adventure Centre, 3733 South Coast Rd
blocks.detail: • ~7 km, 10 min.

blocks.title: Little Sahara — sandboarding and tobogganing
blocks.detail:
• 2 km² of white inland dunes, some as tall as a 17-storey building.
• Toboggans for the kids, sandboard for the adults; wax the base for speed.
• Open 9 AM – 5 PM (Oct–Apr).
blocks.notes: • 2-hr hire AUD 37 per board × 3 = AUD 111 ≈ USD 72 — verified; helmets extra (recommended).

blocks.title: Shake out the sand, change clothes
blocks.detail: • Dry clothes from the day bag before the drive.

blocks.title: Villa — showers, rest
blocks.detail: • Sand out of everything.

blocks.title: Dinner — Kangaroo Island Fresh Seafood, Kingscote
blocks.detail: • Island seafood counter: fish and chips to take back to the villa or eat on the foreshore.
blocks.notes: • ~AUD 75 for 2 adult seafood packs + 2 kids' fish and chips — estimated; menu not online.

blocks.title: Bedtime routine
blocks.detail: • Back by 7 PM — tomorrow leaves at 8 AM.

days.title: Flinders Chase — Remarkable Rocks, Admirals Arch, Hanson Bay koalas

blocks.title: Breakfast — villa
blocks.detail: • From the groceries.

blocks.title: Out the door — picnic water and snacks
blocks.detail: • Fuel up in Kingscote — few stations out west.

blocks.title: Drive Kingscote → Flinders Chase Visitor Centre, 8125 South Coast Rd
blocks.detail: • ~105 km, 1h30 via the Playford and West End Hwys — all sealed.
blocks.notes: • Island fuel for ~600 km of driving over 3 days ≈ AUD 125 (KI fuel is pricier) — estimated.

blocks.title: Visitor Centre — park entry, bathrooms
blocks.detail: • Pay the one-day park fee here (or online).
blocks.notes: • One-day entry: adult AUD 14.40; family listed up to AUD 38 ≈ USD 25 — family rate estimated from the listing range.

blocks.title: Remarkable Rocks
blocks.detail:
• Wind-sculpted granite boulders on a dome 75 m above the sea; boardwalk from the car park.
• Hold the kids' hands near the seaward edge — no fences on the dome.
• Can close in severe wind.

blocks.title: Drive → Admirals Arch, Cape du Couedic
blocks.detail: • ~15 min past the lighthouse.

blocks.title: Admirals Arch boardwalk — long-nosed fur seals
blocks.detail:
• From: the Cape du Couedic car park → boardwalk and stairs down to the arch viewing platform (~10 min each way).
• Fur seals lounging on the rocks below the arch.

blocks.title: Drive back to the Visitor Centre
Lunch — The Rocks Café, Flinders Chase Visitor Centre
blocks.detail: • Café inside the visitor centre.
blocks.notes: • ~AUD 85 for 2 adult + 2 kids' meals — estimated; menu not online.

blocks.title: Drive → Hanson Bay Wildlife Sanctuary, 7797 South Coast Rd
blocks.detail: • ~5 km east of the visitor centre; the last stretch in is gravel.

blocks.title: Hanson Bay — guided Koala Walk (2:30 PM)
blocks.detail:
• Wild koalas in the eucalyptus avenues; kangaroos, wallabies and Cape Barren geese on the way.
• Pre-booked guided tours only (10:30 AM, 2:30 PM, sunset); booking cutoff 1 hr before.
blocks.notes: • From ~AUD 35–40 per adult; child rate not published → ~AUD 120 for the family — estimated. Not booked.

blocks.title: Drive back to Kingscote
blocks.detail: • ~1h30; daylight until ~8:30 PM.

blocks.title: Villa — freshen up
blocks.detail: • Quick showers.

blocks.title: Dinner — Bella Restaurant, Kingscote
blocks.detail: • Italian, 8-min walk from the villa.
blocks.notes: • ~AUD 95 for 2 adult mains + 2 kids' meals incl. optional 10% tip — estimated; menu not online.

blocks.title: Pack + bedtime routine
blocks.detail: • Bags packed tonight for check-out.

days.title: Last island morning — Stokes Bay hidden beach

blocks.title: Breakfast — villa
blocks.detail: • Use up the groceries.

blocks.title: Check out — Villas on the Bay
blocks.detail: • Load the car; leave keys per the villa's instructions.

blocks.title: Drive Kingscote → Stokes Bay
blocks.detail: • ~48 km, 45 min along the north coast.

blocks.title: Stokes Bay — rock tunnel to the hidden beach and rock pool
blocks.detail:
• From: the car park → follow the signs through the rock tunnel (mind your head) → long white beach on the far side.
• Enclosed rock pool = calm, kid-safe swimming; named Australia's Best Beach in 2023.
• Swim gear on under clothes; towels in the car.

blocks.title: Next leg — to plan
blocks.detail:
• Stokes Bay → Penneshaw ferry terminal is ~1h40 if heading back to the mainland.
• Budget KI car returns at Penneshaw; the mainland car is waiting at Cape Jervis.
